name: American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card

apr.notes: Variable APR for purchases and balance transfers 19.49%–29.49% based on creditworthiness. Cash advance APR 29.74% variable. Penalty APR up to 29.99%. Minimum interest charge $0.50. Citi Flex Pay Plan Fee up to 1.72% monthly.

fx_fee.notes: 3% of the U.S. dollar amount of each transaction.

base_rate.description: 1 AAdvantage® mile for every $1 spent on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Earn AAdvantage® miles on eligible purchases. Earn 1 Loyalty Point for every 1 eligible AAdvantage® mile earned from purchases to reach AAdvantage® status faster. No mileage cap — no limit to the number of AAdvantage® miles you can earn.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 15,000 American Airlines AAdvantage® bonus miles after $500 in purchases within the first 3 months of account opening.

benefits.title: 25% Savings on Inflight Food and Beverage
benefits.description: 25% savings on inflight food and beverage purchases on American Airlines flights when you use your credit card.

benefits.title: Add Authorized Users at No Additional Charge
benefits.description: Earn more AAdvantage® miles with purchases made by authorized users added to your account at no additional charge.

benefits.title: No Mileage Cap
benefits.description: No limit to the number of AAdvantage® miles you can earn.

benefits.title: AAdvantage Loyalty Points
benefits.description: Earn 1 Loyalty Point for every 1 eligible AAdvantage® mile earned from purchases to reach AAdvantage® status faster.
